messages:
olivia: Quick check — EU midnight change window in ~2h. We’re doing a rolling slice for model redwood/v2.1. Need final sign-offs: pin, canary smoke, rollback thresholds, release notes. CC @sre-oncall @raj

deploy-bot: Preflight report: capacity OK, canary pool ready, no active incidents. Suggested command: `deploy start --env=eu --model=redwood/v2.1 --strategy=rolling --canary=10% --pin=on`

raj: I submitted a pin for v2.1 on the blue-green slots for 30m default. If we need longer call it out. Rollback criteria I propose: >=2% 5xx across slice OR p95 latency > 750ms for 5m.

maddy: Smoke on canary = PASS (10/10). Ran convo smoke and embeddings sanity. Quick logs in #eng-releases/test-logs, snippet: ```ok: all smoke tests green```

tom: Monitoring: dashboards copied to the release board, alerts wired. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/eu-slice. Added trace tags `release:v2.1` and `slice=midnight`. I’ll be on the watch during the window.

sre-oncall: Oncall acked. Pager is up. Will escalate to infra if CPU >85% for 5m or error budget drains >30%.

ben: Release notes draft pushed (commit `a1b2c3d`). Highlights: small latency improvement and 20% embedding cost reduction for the slice. PR #1423 contains the copy and rollback notes.

olivia: Any blocking migrations or hidden feature flags? Need to confirm no schema work during the window.

raj: No DB migrations. Feature flag `use_v2_embedding` will be flipped after canary is stable. Flip plan: `ff flip use_v2_embedding --percent=10` then 50 then 100.

deploy-bot: Runbook snapshot: `deploy check` => OK. Canary health OK. Next action: `deploy start` to begin the canary. Reaction :rocket:

maddy: If canary stable for 20m we promote. I’ll run the regression eval at +10m and +20m, post results here. Tagging @olivia to confirm promotion.

olivia: GO from me for the EU midnight slice. Keep rollback lane obvious, signal any anomalies here, and oncall will page if needed. :white_check_mark:
